name: publicWeb_getMyHistory
description: The app's Run Counts tab for a signed-in web member (E9.F7.S5) — the app's own three queries (history_list_page.dart) moved server-side. By Kennel = HasherKennelMap Historical* + Hc* per live kennel with any runs; By Country = HC runs (attended, AttendenceState >= 20, counted, visible, started) grouped by the RUN's country (Event.CountryId — a travelling kennel lands in several) merged with the historical counts grouped by the KENNEL's country; Totals = the By Kennel rows summed. The HC-run query has no Event.deleted filter, deliberately, to match the app's local query. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 113, @param NULL); everything is scoped to the token's user. Read-only.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: The browser's HC.Device id. No SQL default.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived token signed for this SP (ValidateAppAuth spNumber 113). No SQL default.

rowsets.name: AuthErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: On a ValidateAppAuth failure: { success = 0, errorCode, errorType } then the detail at index 1; the SP RETURNs.
Error detail after the AuthErrorEnvelope (errorId, errorType, errorCode, errorTitle, errorUserMessage, errorProc).

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: On success, before the data rowsets: { success = 1, errorCode = NULL, errorType = NULL }.

columns.name: IsEstimate
columns.description: 1 when any kennel's historical count is an estimate.

rowsets.name: ByKennel
rowsets.description: On success: one row per live kennel (deleted = 0, removed = 0) where the caller's live HasherKennelMap row has TotalRuns > 0; ORDER BY TotalRuns DESC, KennelShortName. SELECT * from a temp table — column order is the INTO list.

rowsets.name: ByCountry
rowsets.description: On success: one row per country with RunCount > 0, ORDER BY RunCount DESC, CountryName.

columns.name: RunCount
columns.description: HC attended counted runs in the country + historical runs of kennels in the country.

sideEffects: CREATE TABLE #byKennel, #hc, #hist (session temp tables, dropped at the end of the call).
INSERT HC.ErrorLog then THROW in the CATCH.

codeSmells.detail: @deviceId and @accessToken have no SQL default (lines 2-3). A caller that omits one is refused by SQL Server before the procedure runs — an empty 500 with no HC.ErrorLog row (CLAUDE.md 'SP parameter with NO default'). The Next.js client always sends them, so this is latent.

codeSmells.issue: By Country and By Kennel disagree on removed kennels
codeSmells.detail: By Kennel (line 71) drops deleted / removed kennels, but the historical half of By Country (lines 109-113) joins HC.Kennel with no such filter and the HC half (lines 94-101) counts runs of any kennel. A member of a since-removed kennel sees its runs by country but not by kennel or in Totals. Mirrors the app, so a fix belongs on both sides.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
